image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a pale yellow to cream-colored coral fungus (Ramaria or similar genus) growing on a forest floor. The fungus consists of a dense cluster of upright, cylindrical branches that divide repeatedly into finer tips. It sits among brown fallen leaves, twigs, and patches of green moss. The lighting is soft and diffuse, highlighting the complex texture of the fungal branches.
